body.name: L_ret
body.def: Let \(E_{n,b}^{*}=(\inf\widehat\Theta_{n,b}^{*,\mathrm{tot}},\sup\widehat\Theta_{n,b}^{*,\mathrm{tot}})\) and \(E_n=(\inf\widehat\Theta_n^{\mathrm{tot}},\sup\widehat\Theta_n^{\mathrm{tot}})\). Set \(\widehat{\mathbb L}_n^{\mathrm{ret}}=M_n^{-1}\sum_{b=1}^{B_n}J_{n,b}\operatorname{Dirac}_{E_{n,b}^{*}}\) if \(M_n>0\), and set \(\widehat{\mathbb L}_n^{\mathrm{ret}}=\operatorname{Dirac}_{E_n}\) if \(M_n=0\)
body.role: measurable retained-law output with zero-retention fallback
